description: Predict Neurofibromatosis Type 1 case type from patient-level demographic and clinical symptom attributes. Binary target Case Type is encoded as 0 = sporadic case and 1 = familial case. Profile: 296 rows, 18 features, numeric-coded binary clinical signs plus three age fields, missing values in Age of Mother (35), Age of Father (34), and Age at First Diagnosis (4), target distribution 161 sporadic / 135 familial.

plan_checklist.description: Plan includes inspecting schema, feature types, target distribution, and basic data quality before modeling.
Plan includes checking and handling missing values if present.
Plan recognizes numeric-coded binary clinical features and age fields instead of treating all columns as arbitrary continuous variables.
Plan accounts for the small clinical dataset with a simple or regularized model and careful validation.
Plan includes checking class balance and using a stratified or class-aware validation strategy when needed.
Plan uses ROC AUC and an appropriate validation split or cross-validation.
Plan chooses model families suitable for a small tabular binary clinical dataset.

metadata.bench_preprocessing: Converted the Dataset sheet from dataset-uci.xlsx to CSV, dropped the blank row-number/id column, normalized Cafe au lait column spelling to ASCII, and kept Case Type as the binary target.
metadata.class_labels: Case Type: 0 = sporadic case, 1 = familial case. Tumour Case and clinical sign columns: 0 = absent/without, 1 = present/with.
